About

Where marketing strategy meets clean code

I'm a Digital Marketer and Web Designer currently pursuing a Bachelor of Business Administration at D.A.V. (PG) College, Karnal. Over the past couple of years I've worked with healthcare professionals, NGOs, startups, and international clients to build modern websites and sharpen their digital presence.

My toolkit spans WordPress, Elementor and WooCommerce on the build side, and SEO, social media marketing and content strategy on the growth side — plus hands-on experience with payment gateway integration and fully responsive design.

I like sitting at the intersection of the two: a site that looks good is only half the job — it also needs to rank, convert, and be easy to manage after launch.
